about.title: About Us
about.bodyMarkdown:
EasyCashbook is a simple cashbook and notebook app that works everywhere — online or offline. It was built for people who need to track daily income, expenses, and notes without friction — small shop owners, freelancers, or anyone managing personal finances.

## What EasyCashbook does

- **Cashbook:** Log income and expenses by category, track running balances, view summaries at a glance.
- **Notebooks:** Keep quick notes and reminders alongside your financial records.
- **Works offline:** Every entry saves to your device instantly — no internet required day to day.
- **Auto-sync:** When back online, data syncs automatically in the background.

## Our approach

EasyCashbook is offline-first: your data lives on your device first, and cloud sync is a convenience layer on top — not a requirement.

## Our commitment

- We never sell your personal data or your cashbook/notebook content to third parties.
- We collect only what's needed to run your account and sync your data — no more.
- We're upfront about our infrastructure and its limitations — see our Privacy Policy and Terms.

EasyCashbook is developed and maintained by [Your Name / Company Name].

## Contact

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.bodyMarkdown:
EasyCashbook ("we", "our", "the app") is a cashbook and notebook app developed by [Your Name / Company Name]. This policy explains what information we collect, how it's used, how it's stored, and your rights.

## 1. Account information you provide

To create an account, we collect:

- Full name
- Email address
- Password (stored as a one-way hash — we never store or can see your actual password)

Used solely to create and secure your account, identify you at sign-in, and enable sync across devices. Not used for marketing, profiling, or anything beyond operating the app.

## 2. Your cashbook & notebook data

Your entries, categories, and notes are stored:

- Locally on your device at all times, so the app works fully offline, and
- Synced automatically to our server database whenever your device is online, so data is backed up and available across devices.

If offline, changes save locally and sync automatically once reconnected — nothing is lost due to lack of internet.

## 3. How your data is hosted

Our backend runs on third-party cloud infrastructure (application hosting and a managed database provider). These providers host and transmit data on our behalf and do not use it for their own purposes, sell it, or share it with advertisers. We do not sell or rent your personal data or your cashbook/notebook content to any third party, for any purpose.

## 4. Permissions we request

- **Camera** — only if you attach a photo/receipt to an entry.
- **Storage / Media** — to export/import backups (CSV/PDF) or attach images.

## 5. Security

We use encrypted transmission (HTTPS/TLS) between the app and our servers, and password hashing so your actual password is never stored in readable form.

**Honest disclosure:** no method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. We continually work to improve our security practices as the app grows.

## 6. Data sharing

We do not sell your data. We share it only:

- With infrastructure providers strictly to host and run the app (see Section 3)
- When you explicitly export or share a report/entry yourself
- If required by law

## 7. Your rights & account deletion

You can request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time:

- In-app: Settings → Account → Delete My Account
- Online: email us at the address below

Deleting your account permanently removes your synced data from our servers. Data stored only on your device is removed when you uninstall the app or clear app data.

## 8. Children's privacy

EasyCashbook is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from children.

## 9. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by an updated effective date and, where appropriate, an in-app notice.

## Contact
